summary: Most diffs match the injected CSS variants (borders, spacing, typography, chart heights, 2-column layout) and look fine on desktop. On phone, the typography and layout changes break things: the header title wraps and clips the nav, the orders table overflows, and the full page becomes wider than the viewport. Several phone snapshots also capture the wrong area of the page, so the tests themselves need a look.

suggestions.summary: Button corners are less rounded (border-radius 4px).
suggestions.details: Matches the "borders" variant: .btn { border-radius: 4px }. Only the button corners change.

suggestions.summary: The phone snapshot doesn't show the buttons row: it captures part of the orders table.
suggestions.details: Both expected and actual show the orders table instead of the buttons row, so the locator screenshot is capturing the wrong area on the phone project. The diff itself is a small vertical shift of that content. Worth fixing the test before trusting this snapshot.
suggestions.group: Phone snapshots capture the wrong area

suggestions.summary: Bar heights changed to the new chart values.
suggestions.details: Matches the "chart" variant, which sets new heights for each .chart-bar. Layout and colors are unchanged.

suggestions.summary: Bar heights changed to the new chart values.
suggestions.details: Same "chart" variant as on desktop: every bar is taller, nothing else moves.

suggestions.summary: Weekly chart bars have new heights.
suggestions.details: The chart card shows the same "chart" variant heights; title and axis labels are unchanged.

suggestions.summary: Weekly chart bars have new heights.
suggestions.details: Same "chart" variant as on desktop. Not checked in detail on phone.

suggestions.summary: Stats and feature cards switch to a 2-column grid, chart is taller.
suggestions.details: Matches the "layout" variant (2-column .stats and .cards-grid, 200px chart). The third feature card sits alone on its row, which is expected with 2 columns.

suggestions.summary: The page is now wider than the phone viewport (585px vs 412px).
suggestions.details: The forced 2-column grids from the "layout" variant don't fit on phone: the full-page screenshot grew to 585px wide, which means horizontal scrolling, and the stat cards are cramped. The 2-column rule probably needs a mobile breakpoint.

suggestions.details: Matches the "borders" variant on .feature-card.

suggestions.details: Both expected and actual show the orders table instead of the analytics feature card, so the locator screenshot is capturing the wrong area on the phone project. The diff itself is a small vertical shift of that content. Worth fixing the test before trusting this snapshot.
